raw_blocks: SUPERIOR PIPING SOLUTIONS THAT EXCEED EXPECTATIONS

At PERMA-PIPE International Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: PPIH), integrity is at the core of everything we do. We deliver durable, high-performance pipe systems that meet the toughest standards while continuously innovating to enhance quality, efficiency, and sustainability. Guided by our core values, we remain committed to customer satisfaction, product excellence, and environmental responsibility—ensuring solutions you can trust.

With expertise in anti-corrosion coatings, insulation solutions, containment systems, custom fabrication, leak detection systems, and comprehensive technical support, field service, and logistics, we’re ready to be your trusted partner in piping system solutions.
Let’s build the future of pipe systems—together.
Supporting the Industries That Keep the World Moving

Efficient Energy Distribution District energy systems use pre-insulated piping to transport steam, hot water, and chilled water, providing reliable heating and cooling for commercial and industrial sites. They optimize performance, reduce costs, and enhance energy efficiency and sustainability at scale.

Reliable Piping Solutions From energy production to essential manufacturing, the energy and industrial sector drives modern economies and demands safe, reliable transport solutions. PERMA-PIPE’s pre-insulated piping and containment systems provide robust, end-to-end sealing to prevent corrosion and ensure long-lasting durability.

Essential Mining Solutions Reliable piping is essential for transporting water, slurry, chemicals, and gases in demanding mining conditions. Pre-insulated pipes offer a durable solution, protecting against damage, optimizing energy efficiency, and enhancing safety. Ideal for harsh climates and remote locations, they ensure long-term performance in extreme environments.
The Solutions You Can Rely On.

We deliver high-performance insulation solutions, reliable containment systems, top-tier anti-corrosion coatings, custom fabrication, and advanced leak detection technology. Trusted worldwide, our solutions go beyond materials—we collaborate with customers to create customized piping systems that exceed project requirements. With a focus on precision, reliability, and innovation, we tackle even the most complex challenges.
Learn more about our products

PERMA-PIPE manufactures and supplies pre-insulated piping solutions, containment systems, anti-corrosion coatings, custom fabrication and leak detection systems, offering products tailored to meet client requirements and specifications. We support you at every stage, providing expert planning, engineering and technical assistance, material consulting, specification guidance, calculations, logistics, and dedicated project management. With a team of experienced professionals, we deliver customized solutions to keep your project on track—no matter the complexity.
Count on us for high-quality products and services crafted to meet your exact requirements.

PERMA-PIPE International Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: PPIH) is a global leader in engineered pipe services, specializing in anti-corrosion coatings, insulation solutions, containment systems, custom fabrication, leak detection, technical support, field service, and logistics.

raw_blocks: Global Leader in Piping Innovation

At PERMA-PIPE, we pride ourselves on being a worldwide leader in engineered piping solutions. Our expertise spans anti-corrosion coatings, advanced insulation solutions, containment systems, custom fabrication, and cutting-edge leak detection technology.

With decades of industry experience and certifications in ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001, we are committed to delivering reliable, high-performance solutions tailored to the unique demands of every project, no matter how complex.

From initial concept to final implementation, our comprehensive suite of services is crafted to exceed expectations, ensuring smooth execution and exceptional results. When you choose PERMA-PIPE, you’re partnering with a team that combines unparalleled expertise, innovation, and dedication to driving your project’s success.
Discover the PERMA-PIPE difference — where innovation and reliability flow together seamlessly.
XTRU-THERM features thermally efficient polyurethane (PUR) insulation, a waterproof high-density polyethylene (HDPE) outer jacket, and a durable service pipe.
Each component is fabricated in an ISO 9000 facility to ensure top-quality control.
Polyurethane insulation is gap-free and securely attached to the pipe and jacket, ensuring consistent thermal performance.
The watertight outer jacket prevents corrosion under insulation (CUI), reducing the need for inspections, repairs, replacements, and downtime.
The insulation provides long-term reliability with materials and techniques that minimize damage during construction and operation, maximizing investment returns.
PUR density 2 lbs/ft3 (32kg/m3 ) to 15 lbs/ft3 (240kg/m3) (nominal)
PIPE SIZE: XTRU-THERM can be processed in a wide variety of pipe lengths, weights, and diameters.

Composed of highly efficient polyurethane (PUR) or polyisocyanurate (PIR) insulation
Durable fiberglass-reinforced polymer (FRP) outer jacket that resists water infiltration
Service pipe meets the highest standards
Fabricated in an ISO 9000 facility for consistent quality control

Ideal for steam and hot water transportation, engineered to withstand extreme temperatures and secondary containment applications.
Core components include a steel carrier pipe supported by aerogel insulation.
Features a thermally efficient configuration with a steel conduit pipe, polyurethane foam insulation, and a waterproof outer jacket.

Features remarkable strength, excellent adhesion, and superb toughness for subsea components such as flowlines, risers, field joints, jumpers, PLETs, PLEMs, inline structures, shrouds, and doghouses.
Ideal for deep and ultra-deepwater applications.
Suitable for various operating conditions and applications.
FEATURES: MAXIMUM OPERATING TEMPERATURE: FLOW-THERM Si (Silicone Rubber) 356°F (180°C) FLOW-THERM RS 3604 (Polymer Alloy) 284°F (140°C) FLOW-THERM GSPU (Glass Syntactic Polyurethane) 226°F(109°C)
PIPE SIZE: FLOW-THERM can be processed in a wide variety of pipe lengths, weights, and diameters.
PVC-THERM piping system is a cost-effective solution for aboveground and underground applications, handling temperatures up to 250°F (121°C).
Ideal for low-budget projects with easy field management of joint and fitting insulation.
Available in various forms, including straight sections of pipe and standard lengths, with multiple material options.
Pipes are pre-insulated and jacketed at the factory, arriving ready for installation.
Pre-molded covers are available for tees, elbows, flanges, and couplings, with polyurethane foam and mixing aids for efficient installation.
Contractor typically provides necessary pipe fittings.
Sealing tape is included to ensure watertight connections between adjacent components in both aboveground and underground systems.

For over 30 years, GALVA-GARD has set the standard for protecting subterranean distribution systems, delivering unmatched durability and corrosion resistance. By combining the strength of galvanized steel with the resilience of fiberglass, GALVA-GARD ensures long-lasting performance in even the most demanding environments. Purpose-built for both below-ground and extreme above-ground conditions, it provides a reliable, high-performance solution for subsurface heat distribution, standing up to the toughest challenges with confidence.
Key components of the GAVA-GARD system
Steel carrier pipe with aerogel insulation
Hot dipped galvanized steel conduit
Benefits of the GALVA-GARD system
The conduit is hot dipped galvanized and coated with fiberglass cladding
Fiberglass cladding is highly resistant to acids, alkali’s, salts and chemical found in soil
The cladding has high dielectric strength and is designed to withstand 421 Volt/mil spark testing
The casing can withstand earth and H2O traffic loads
The cladding resists stress from handling, soil movement, and backfill compaction
No pipe coating can match the performance of GALVA-GARD’s fiberglass cladding
Temperature Range: 250°F to 750°F (Standard) Above 750°F (Special)
Maximum Pressure: Determined by service pipe selected
Pipe Sizes: Nom. Diameter 1/2” - 36” Nom. Length 20’ and 40’
Applications: Pre-insulated piping system for below ground distribution of steam, hot water and other high temperature fluids

ULTRA-THERM is a high-performance solution engineered for the secure underground transport of hazardous chemicals. As part of a robust double-pipe system, it provides an extra layer of protection, ensuring maximum safety and reliability in the most demanding environments. Built to withstand corrosive materials and extreme conditions, ULTRA-THERM delivers long-term durability and peace of mind for critical chemical distribution applications.
Key features of the ULTRA-THERM system:
Outer casing is made of 10-gauge steel clad with a thick layer of filament-wound fiberglass reinforced plastic.
This fiberglass-clad system offers maximum resistance to adverse environmental conditions and is built to combat corrosion.
Combines the strength of steel with the corrosion resistance of fiberglass.
Fiberglass cladding is highly resistant to acids, alkalis, salts and chemicals found in soil.
The material has high dielectric strength and is designed to withstand 421 volt/mil spark testing.
Developed specifically for underground applications and severe above-grade environments.
Fiberglass cladding is filament-wound directly onto a shot-blasted steel conduit.
The smoothwall conduit is chosen for its small seam, ensuring complete bonding of the cladding to the casing.

The ultimate prefabricated, pre-insulated piping system for delivering low to high-pressure steam, high-temperature hot water, and a wide range of fluid transportation needs. Engineered for superior thermal efficiency and durability, it ensures reliable performance in the most demanding conditions, making it the go-to solution for high-performance distribution systems.
This advanced coating provides exceptional corrosion resistance for underground steel conduit systems.
Applied hot over shot-blasted steel casing at our factory, it adheres to strict quality standards for long-lasting protection.
The piping system is supported with insulated supports placed at 10-foot intervals, ensuring the service pipe remains centered within the conduit casing.
PERMA-PIPE’s support configuration allows full insulation of the service pipe, maximizing thermal efficiency while enhancing drainability and dryability.
This innovative support approach also enables the installation of a cable-type leak detection and location system.
Electric or Steam Heat Trace (Optional)
With over 40 years of expertise, PERMA-PIPE leads the industry in crafting high-quality prefabricated systems.
Our proprietary CAD programs integrate key parameters such as service pipe stress, heat transfer, and soil loading to ensure optimal performance.
Rest assured, the engineering behind your distribution system is built on cutting-edge technology and innovation.
Determined by service pipes selected
Nom. Diameter 1/2” - 36”
Nom. Length 20’ and 40’
Applications: Industrial & Municipal Steam Transmission Geothermal Collection District Heating Cogeneration Process Fluid Transport Transportation of Fuel & Heavy Oil Solar Collection & Distribution

Chil-Gard is a fully pre-insulated system built for reliable underground chilled water distribution. Engineered for efficiency, it minimizes heat gain with a seamless integration of high-performance insulation across all components. By using uniform materials throughout, Chil-Gard maximizes thermal efficiency while streamlining installation, allowing for precise upfront cost estimation. The result—long-term energy savings, reduced maintenance, and a dependable solution for even the most demanding chilled water applications.
PVC Service Pipe: Gasketed bell joint construction accommodates pipe movement and eliminates expansion and contraction stresses within the system. No additional expansion devices are needed.

Polyurethane Foam Insulation: Polyurethane foam insulation completely fills the annular space between the service pipe and the outer jacket and has the lowest thermal conductivity of all commercial insulation 0.16 Btu-in/hr-ft²-°F.
PVC Outer Jacket: Polyvinyl chloride plastic outer jacket provides tough, rigid, yet flexible protection for both the insulation and inner service pipe.
Fittings: Straight lengths and fittings are joined with integral bell and spigot joints, including a rubber sealing ring.
Advanced Abrasion Resistant Outer (ARO) wrap
Expertly engineered for exceptional protection
Guards against impacts, gouging, abrasions, and fractures
Ideal for safeguarding pre-insulated piping
Particularly advantageous in challenging terrains
Effective for trenchless installation techniques like horizontal directional drilling or boring
Temperature Range: Determined by insulation system used
Maximum Pressure: Determined by the carrier pipe selected
Pipe Sizes: From 0.25 inches to 72 inches

Service Pipe Materials: Project dependent but may include: Carbon Steel Stainless-Steel High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Glass-Reinforced Polymer (GRP) Fiber-Reinforced Polymer (FRP) Reinforced Thermosetting Resin (RTR) Glass Reinforced Epoxy (GRE) Ductile Iron Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Copper and many more.
APPLICATIONS: Onshore Pipelines Shallow Water Pipelines Abrasion Resistant Overcoat Horizontal Drilling and Boring Difficult Terrain Installations
Ideal for steam and hot water transportation, configured to withstand extreme temperatures and secondary containment applications.
FEATURES: OPERATING TEMPERATURE RANGE: • Up to 750°F (399°C)
PIPE SIZE: • MULTI-THERM is processed in a wide variety of pipe lengths, weighs and diameters.
• Please contact PERMA-PIPE with your project’s specific requirements.
APPLICATIONS: • District Energy • Environmental Protection • Energy & Industrial • Mining

Our Double Pipe system is a reliable and safe solution for preventing leakage of hazardous liquids and corrosive substances.
Consists of a carrier pipe encased in a urethane or FRP outer jacket, with an optional PermAlert® cable leak detection system.
Ensures optimal protection against expensive environmental or safety incidents.
Efficiently distributes and confines hazardous fluids and process liquids in both underground and aboveground applications.
Minimizes the risk of accidental leaks or spills, reducing environmental damage and potential harm to personnel.
Superior construction and advanced leak detection technology make it ideal for industries prioritizing safety and environmental responsibility.
Provides businesses with assurance of safeguarded operations against potentially dangerous situations.

TYPE FS TYPE FS utilizes any type of product pipe(s) for maximum service pipe integrity inside a fiberglass containment. The Type FS piping system is constructed with both a supply and return line in a single containment for emergency power generation systems. Additional applications include jet hydrants fuels and industrial waste drain piping systems. Options include leak detection and electric heat tracing systems.

TYPE IW TYPE IW is an all-alloy steel piping system used where fluid is corrosive, and temperature limits do not allow the use of thermoplastic or thermoset materials. The piping system can be furnished with a variety of pipe coatings on the outer containment. Applications include low level radiation waste lines, elevated temperature and/or pressure chemical services chemical or biological process waste systems. Options include leak detection and electric heat tracing systems.

TYPE HT TYPE HT is designed for high-temperature containment applications where carbon steel pipe is the appropriate product and containment selection. The outer containment is protected from corrosion with a urethane coating for below grade installations. For above grade installations any common industrial coating can be supplied. Applications for the system include fuel oil, diesel, gasoline, high temperature process sewers and petroleum refinery “NESHAP” compliance. Options include leak detection and electric heat tracing systems.
FEATURES: OPERATING TEMPERATURE RANGE: • 32°F (0°C) to 300°F (149°C)
PIPE SIZE: • DOUBLE PIPE is processed in a wide variety of pipe lengths, weights and diameters.
APPLICATIONS : • District Energy • Energy & Industrial
DOUBLE CONTAINMENT PIPE BROCHURE DOUBLE CONTAINMENT PIPE DATASHEET DOUBLE CONTAINMENT VIDEO

The Ultra-Series is a family of non-corrosive steel piping systems engineered for environmental piping applications. Backed by years of hands-on expertise and insights from consulting engineers nationwide, The Ultra-Series represents the pinnacle of innovation in durable piping solutions. By seamlessly combining the strength of steel with the corrosion resistance of fiberglass, this advanced system delivers unmatched reliability and longevity in even the most demanding conditions.
Backed by over 50 years of experience
Prefabricated to job site dimensions
Supplied with a part drawing layout indicating where each piece is installed by the contractor

ULTRA-HT ULTRA-HT is the most thermally efficient solution for environmentally sensitive media distribution requiring precise temperature control. It offers complete flexibility by allowing any steel alloy combination for the inner and outer containment piping, ensuring compatibility with your specific application. The insulated outer pipe maintains critical temperatures, while ULTRA-HT can be configured to accommodate multiple pipes—optimizing pipe rack space and minimizing trench width. For enhanced thermal management, PERMA-PIPE’s electric heat tracing system is available as an option.

ULTRA-PIPE ULTRA-PIPE is the ultimate solution for corrosion-resistant steel piping. It features a .100-inch-thick filament-wound fiberglass cladding that eliminates the need for cathodic protection, reducing maintenance and extending system life. Ideal for applications such as chilled water, condenser water, and hydrocarbon product transport, ULTRA-PIPE delivers durability and performance in demanding environments.

ULTRA-FS ULTRA-FS stands as the most advanced piping system on the market. It features carbon steel product pipes enclosed within a steel outer containment pipe, clad with .100-inch-thick fiberglass for superior corrosion resistance. This innovative construction removes the need for cathodic protection, simplifying installation and long-term maintenance. Designed for a wide range of fuel applications—including No. 2 diesel for backup generators, gasoline distribution pipelines, and fuel tank farms—ULTRA-FS is also a trusted choice for jet fuel hydrant piping systems in commercial and military airports. Available options include leak detection and electric heat tracing systems for enhanced safety and reliability.

ULTRA-IW ULTRA-IW is a high-performance piping system constructed from stainless steel, nickel, or duplex alloy, encased in a .100-inch-thick fiberglass-clad containment. Engineered for the toughest environments, it is specifically suited for high-temperature corrosive fluids, Category M fluids, biologic waste, low-level radioactive materials, pharmaceutical waste, and industrial process waste. Designed for applications demanding the highest level of environmental protection, ULTRA-IW also offers optional leak detection and electric heat tracing systems to ensure maximum safety and compliance.
PERMA-PIPE’s custom-engineered steel manholes are prefabricated and pre-insulated.
Provide outstanding strength and durability
100% watertight, built to stay dry
Ready to install, reducing installation and life-cycle maintenance costs compared to traditional concrete manholes
Built with one-inch vents welded to the conduit ends for convenient moisture inspection
Allows for drainage if the conduit is wet
Enables drying of insulation and air-testing of the conduit to ensure watertightness
Reduces onsite time and labor maintenance costs for operators
For long-term quality, durability, and performance value, PERMA-PIPE’s prefabricated steel manholes are the best solution for any application:
Smaller footprint than precast concrete
Fully assembled and tested with all valves and other equipment installed as required.
Piping and valves are pre-insulated and air testable to ensure water tightness
Outer surface is coated with spray-applied urethane for corrosion protection
Factory quality controlled and tested
Capability to retrofit a failing existing vault or manhole
Same warranty as the piping system
FABRICATED MANHOLE BROCHURE FABRICATED MANHOLE VIDEO

The ELECTRO-GARD system is an advanced electro-fusion welded field joint system for pre-insulated pipes, providing superior protection and insulation for field joints through innovative HDPE fusion technology.
High-Protection Electro-Fusion Welding Uses state-of-the-art electro-fusion welding for HDPE to ensure maximum durability of the field joint insulation.
Open Sleeve Configuration The open sleeve Configuration eliminates the need to place the joint on the pipe jacket before welding, simplifying installation.
Insulation Options Allows for direct foam injection or pre-inspection of the foam before applying the Electro-Gard joint kit.
Fully Automated Welding Process Electro-fusion is achieved by an electrical coil that melts the pipe surface and the field joint casing, ensuring full fusion.
The Electro-fusion welding machine automatically sets parameters like welding time and voltage, optimizing the process.
Microprocessor-Controlled Monitoring A microprocessor monitors and adjusts energy supply throughout the welding phases, with parameters recorded and archived for quality control and traceability.

Features and Benefits The configuration of the joint systems ensures durability and extreme toughness. For any application where joints are deemed to be exposed to high forces or the consequences of a potential leak caused by failing joint systems is unacceptable, the Electro-Gard is the right answer.
100% Adhesion to adjacent pipe
Not sensible to salt water/chlorides
Easy installation with automated equipment
Same material properties as the casing on the pipe
No need to place the joint on pipe jacket prior to welding
Can be used from 225mm jacket size and up

SLEEVE-GARD 80 is a high-temperature shrink sleeve that can withstand continuous operating temperatures up to 176°F (80°C) makes the SLEEVE-GARD 80 suitable for aboveground applications where the surface temperature of the pipe or jacket can exceed 140°F (60°C) in direct sunlight. It is better than low temperature sleeves for belowground applications where the sleeves can be exposed to direct sunlight for extended periods before burial. It is also intended for hot piping or jackets up to 176°F (80°C) whether above or belowground.

Product Description PERMA-PIPE’s SLEEVE-GARD 80 shrink sleeve system consist of a cross-linked polyolefin sleeve providing superior mechanical protection with a specially formulated heat-activated mastic which offers excellent corrosion protection and resistance to water ingress for above and belowground piping systems. The system is suitable for use on most common pre-insulated piping system jackets such as FRP, HDPE, PVC and pipeline coatings such as fusion bonded, epoxy and urethane.

At PERMA-PIPE, we specialize in complete custom fabrication, delivering fully fabricated systems from start to finish. Unlike others who may focus only on bends and tees, we build entire systems tailored to your specifications. Whether it’s complex configurations or standard assemblies, we handle every step with precision and expertise.

Our capabilities extend to all materials, diameters, and wall thicknesses, utilizing plate and piping to create custom bends, tees, and more. Our process includes shaping, cutting, bending, profiling, fitting, and welding to ensure every component is built to the highest standards.

We leverage a range of welding techniques—manual, semi-automatic, and orbital welding—across all major welding processes to suit the unique needs of each project. Beyond fabrication, we offer comprehensive testing and finishing services, including non-destructive examination (NDE), hydrotesting, blasting, coating, and insulation.
With PERMA-PIPE, you can trust that your project will be completed with quality, safety, and efficiency in mind.
Insulating the conductor casing prevents the permafrost layers surrounding the well from thawing
Double containment insulated piping ensures the structural integrity of the well casing
Provides a robust defense against thawing
Helps safeguard the overall stability of the well system.
APPLICATIONS: • Energy & Industrial
Our anti-corrosion coatings are formulated to withstand high temperatures
Coatings can be applied in multiple layers, each customized to the specific thickness needed for your pipelines
Protects pipelines from external corrosion and extends their lifespan
Provides a variety of features and options to meet performance and budgetary requirements
Ensures the perfect coating solution for your piping system needs
OPERATING TEMPERATURE RANGE: • -40°F (-40°C) to 140°F (60°C)
MINIMUM LAYER THICKNESS (Full System) FUSION BONDED EPOXY (FBE) • 305 µm (12 mils)
MOISTURE RESISTANT OVERCOAT (MRO) • 762 µm (30 mils)
ABRASION RESISTANT OVERCOAT (ARO) • 762 µm (30 mils, 40 mils)
RUBBERIZED ASPHALT (RA) • Applied as per CSA-Z245.21 • Bespoke thicknesses available

FAB-COAT provides a cost-effective coating solution for internal and external surfaces
Available in both powder and liquid coating processes
Ensures durability and longevity of piping systems
Extends the lifespan of pipes
Trusted as a premier coating solution for piping system protection.
EXPERT ENGINEERING AND TECHNICAL SUPPORT AT EVERY STAGE

We provide the expertise and support needed to ensure success from start to finish. Our team of skilled specialists is dedicated to delivering tailored solutions at every stage of your project—from working through detailed Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) studies to overseeing installation.
• Stress analysis and calculations
• Pipeline support load calculations
Trust PERMA-PIPE for reliable, high-precision technical support crafted to propel your project forward.

PERMA-PIPE manufactures and supplies anti-corrosion coatings, pre-insulated piping solutions, containment systems, custom fabrication and leak detection technology, offering products customized to client requirements and specifications. While we support projects with our expertise, we do not serve as the engineer-of-record. Any document stamping, if required, is incidental to our role as a product manufacturer and supplier, not as an architect, engineer, or surveyor.

Provides a high-quality insulation system with thermal efficiency.
Offers significant cost savings in installation, operation, and maintenance
FEATURES: OPERATING TEMPERATURE RANGE: -219°F (-195°C)
For specific temperature requirements, please contact PERMA-PIPE.
HI-GARD can be processed in a wide variety of pipe lengths, weights, and diameters
Contact PERMA-PIPE with your project’s specific requirements
FLOW-THERM is a subsea insulation offering exceptional compressive resistance, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.
Features remarkable strength, excellent adhesion, and superb toughness for subsea components such as flowlines, risers, field joints, jumpers, PLETs, PLEMs, inline structures, shrouds, and doghouses.
Ideal for deep and ultra-deepwater applications.
Suitable for various operating conditions and applications.
FEATURES: MAXIMUM OPERATING TEMPERATURE: FLOW-THERM Si (Silicone Rubber) 356°F (180°C) FLOW-THERM RS 3604 (Polymer Alloy) 284°F (140°C) FLOW-THERM GSPU (Glass Syntactic Polyurethane) 226°F(109°C)
PIPE SIZE: FLOW-THERM can be processed in a wide variety of pipe lengths, weights, and diameters.
PVC-THERM piping system is a cost-effective solution for aboveground and underground applications, handling temperatures up to 250°F (121°C).
Ideal for low-budget projects with easy field management of joint and fitting insulation.
Available in various forms, including straight sections of pipe and standard lengths, with multiple material options.
Pipes are pre-insulated and jacketed at the factory, arriving ready for installation.
Pre-molded covers are available for tees, elbows, flanges, and couplings, with polyurethane foam and mixing aids for efficient installation.
Contractor typically provides necessary pipe fittings.
Sealing tape is included to ensure watertight connections between adjacent components in both aboveground and underground systems.
FEATURES: OPERATING TEMPERATURE RANGE: 32°F (0°C) to 250°F (121°C)
PIPE SIZE: PVC-THERM can be processed in a wide variety of pipe lengths, weights, and diameters.

For over 30 years, GALVA-GARD has set the standard for protecting subterranean distribution systems, delivering unmatched durability and corrosion resistance. By combining the strength of galvanized steel with the resilience of fiberglass, GALVA-GARD ensures long-lasting performance in even the most demanding environments. Purpose-built for both below-ground and extreme above-ground conditions, it provides a reliable, high-performance solution for subsurface heat distribution, standing up to the toughest challenges with confidence.
Key components of the GAVA-GARD system
Steel carrier pipe with aerogel insulation
Hot dipped galvanized steel conduit
Benefits of the GALVA-GARD system
The conduit is hot dipped galvanized and coated with fiberglass cladding
Fiberglass cladding is highly resistant to acids, alkali’s, salts and chemical found in soil
The cladding has high dielectric strength and is designed to withstand 421 Volt/mil spark testing
The casing can withstand earth and H2O traffic loads
The cladding resists stress from handling, soil movement, and backfill compaction
No pipe coating can match the performance of GALVA-GARD’s fiberglass cladding
Temperature Range: 250°F to 750°F (Standard) Above 750°F (Special)
Maximum Pressure: Determined by service pipe selected
Pipe Sizes: Nom. Diameter 1/2” - 36” Nom. Length 20’ and 40’
Applications: Pre-insulated piping system for below ground distribution of steam, hot water and other high temperature fluids

ULTRA-THERM is a high-performance solution engineered for the secure underground transport of hazardous chemicals. As part of a robust double-pipe system, it provides an extra layer of protection, ensuring maximum safety and reliability in the most demanding environments. Built to withstand corrosive materials and extreme conditions, ULTRA-THERM delivers long-term durability and peace of mind for critical chemical distribution applications.
Key features of the ULTRA-THERM system:
Outer casing is made of 10-gauge steel clad with a thick layer of filament-wound fiberglass reinforced plastic.
This fiberglass-clad system offers maximum resistance to adverse environmental conditions and is built to combat corrosion.
Combines the strength of steel with the corrosion resistance of fiberglass.
Fiberglass cladding is highly resistant to acids, alkalis, salts and chemicals found in soil.
The material has high dielectric strength and is designed to withstand 421 volt/mil spark testing.
Developed specifically for underground applications and severe above-grade environments.
Fiberglass cladding is filament-wound directly onto a shot-blasted steel conduit.
The smoothwall conduit is chosen for its small seam, ensuring complete bonding of the cladding to the casing.

The ultimate prefabricated, pre-insulated piping system for delivering low to high-pressure steam, high-temperature hot water, and a wide range of fluid transportation needs. Engineered for superior thermal efficiency and durability, it ensures reliable performance in the most demanding conditions, making it the go-to solution for high-performance distribution systems.
This advanced coating provides exceptional corrosion resistance for underground steel conduit systems.
Applied hot over shot-blasted steel casing at our factory, it adheres to strict quality standards for long-lasting protection.
The piping system is supported with insulated supports placed at 10-foot intervals, ensuring the service pipe remains centered within the conduit casing.
PERMA-PIPE’s support configuration allows full insulation of the service pipe, maximizing thermal efficiency while enhancing drainability and dryability.
This innovative support approach also enables the installation of a cable-type leak detection and location system.
Electric or Steam Heat Trace (Optional)
With over 40 years of expertise, PERMA-PIPE leads the industry in crafting high-quality prefabricated systems.
Our proprietary CAD programs integrate key parameters such as service pipe stress, heat transfer, and soil loading to ensure optimal performance.
Rest assured, the engineering behind your distribution system is built on cutting-edge technology and innovation.
Determined by service pipes selected
Nom. Diameter 1/2” - 36”
Nom. Length 20’ and 40’
Applications: Industrial & Municipal Steam Transmission Geothermal Collection District Heating Cogeneration Process Fluid Transport Transportation of Fuel & Heavy Oil Solar Collection & Distribution

Chil-Gard is a fully pre-insulated system built for reliable underground chilled water distribution. Engineered for efficiency, it minimizes heat gain with a seamless integration of high-performance insulation across all components. By using uniform materials throughout, Chil-Gard maximizes thermal efficiency while streamlining installation, allowing for precise upfront cost estimation. The result—long-term energy savings, reduced maintenance, and a dependable solution for even the most demanding chilled water applications.
PVC Service Pipe: Gasketed bell joint construction accommodates pipe movement and eliminates expansion and contraction stresses within the system. No additional expansion devices are needed.

Polyurethane Foam Insulation: Polyurethane foam insulation completely fills the annular space between the service pipe and the outer jacket and has the lowest thermal conductivity of all commercial insulation 0.16 Btu-in/hr-ft²-°F.
PVC Outer Jacket: Polyvinyl chloride plastic outer jacket provides tough, rigid, yet flexible protection for both the insulation and inner service pipe.
Fittings: Straight lengths and fittings are joined with integral bell and spigot joints, including a rubber sealing ring.
Advanced Abrasion Resistant Outer (ARO) wrap
Expertly engineered for exceptional protection
Guards against impacts, gouging, abrasions, and fractures
Ideal for safeguarding pre-insulated piping
Particularly advantageous in challenging terrains
Effective for trenchless installation techniques like horizontal directional drilling or boring
Temperature Range: Determined by insulation system used
Maximum Pressure: Determined by the carrier pipe selected
Pipe Sizes: From 0.25 inches to 72 inches

Service Pipe Materials: Project dependent but may include: Carbon Steel Stainless-Steel High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Glass-Reinforced Polymer (GRP) Fiber-Reinforced Polymer (FRP) Reinforced Thermosetting Resin (RTR) Glass Reinforced Epoxy (GRE) Ductile Iron Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Copper and many more.
APPLICATIONS: Onshore Pipelines Shallow Water Pipelines Abrasion Resistant Overcoat Horizontal Drilling and Boring Difficult Terrain Installations
Ideal for steam and hot water transportation, configured to withstand extreme temperatures and secondary containment applications.

PIPE SIZE: • MULTI-THERM is processed in a wide variety of pipe lengths, weighs and diameters.

APPLICATIONS: • District Energy • Environmental Protection • Energy & Industrial • Mining

Our Double Pipe system is a reliable and safe solution for preventing leakage of hazardous liquids and corrosive substances.
Consists of a carrier pipe encased in a urethane or FRP outer jacket, with an optional PermAlert® cable leak detection system.
Ensures optimal protection against expensive environmental or safety incidents.
Efficiently distributes and confines hazardous fluids and process liquids in both underground and aboveground applications.
Minimizes the risk of accidental leaks or spills, reducing environmental damage and potential harm to personnel.
Superior construction and advanced leak detection technology make it ideal for industries prioritizing safety and environmental responsibility.
Provides businesses with assurance of safeguarded operations against potentially dangerous situations.

TYPE FS TYPE FS utilizes any type of product pipe(s) for maximum service pipe integrity inside a fiberglass containment. The Type FS piping system is constructed with both a supply and return line in a single containment for emergency power generation systems. Additional applications include jet hydrants fuels and industrial waste drain piping systems. Options include leak detection and electric heat tracing systems.

raw_blocks: PERMA-PIPE International Holdings, Inc., (NASDAQ: PPIH) is a globally recognized leader in cutting-edge engineered piping solutions. We specialize in advanced insulation solutions, containment systems, anti-corrosion coatings, custom fabrication, leak detection, engineering and technical support, field service, and logistics. For decades, our expertise has set the benchmark in the industry, reinforced by globally respected certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.

With ten strategically located production facilities across the globe — including the United States, Eastern and Western Canada, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and India — we combine localized service with worldwide reach. This global footprint allows us to scale quickly and efficiently, meeting the most complex piping challenges, no matter the project size or location.

At PERMA-PIPE, we go beyond delivering products — we create solutions that redefine industry standards. What sets us apart is our unwavering commitment to innovation, sustainability, and close collaboration with our customers. We develop systems customized to meet even the most complex piping requirements, from extreme high-temperature environments to cryogenic conditions.

Our advanced leak detection technology, along with enhanced and customized products like double containment systems and anti-corrosion solutions, are built with environmental safety and project integrity in mind. By addressing the full lifecycle of your piping infrastructure, we ensure long-term cost efficiency and reliable performance.

Our global network and team of dedicated technical professionals deliver unmatched expertise and support. From concept to completion, PERMA-PIPE partners with you to achieve excellence, ensuring your project is completed on time, on budget, and beyond expectations.
Choose PERMA-PIPE — where industry-leading innovation, global reach, and unwavering dedication makes us the trusted partner for your most critical piping projects.

PERMA-PIPE is extremely proud of the principles that shape and drive our operations. We consistently strive to uphold the highest standards of professional ethics and personal integrity in all aspects of our business. The commitment to excellence will remain steadfast as we move forward. The principles of PERMA-PIPE form the bedrock on which our code of conduct is built, ensuring that we maintain a strong foundation for success.
No accidents. No injuries. Be responsible for your own and other’s safety.
Seek out, appreciate and encourage innovation, creativity, and out-of-the-box thinking.
Tell the truth, be reliable, transparent and do the right thing.
Work with your customers and coworkers to identify and solve problems. Never settle for status quo.
Treat others as you want to be treated — with trust, dignity and respect.
Own your actions, decisions and responsibilities.
Environmental, Social, and Governance Statement

We are committed to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles that drive responsible and sustainable business practices. Our Environmental Management Systems (EMS) guide efforts to reduce our environmental impact through energy efficiency, resource optimization, and waste reduction. In addition, several of our operations hold ISO 14001 accreditation, supporting compliance with local environmental regulations.

Socially, we foster an inclusive, equitable workplace and support community initiatives that reflect our values. On the governance front, our status as a publicly traded U.S. company demands high standards, which we uphold through a proactive Board of Directors and strict ethical guidelines for employees, suppliers, and partners.
By engaging stakeholders and embedding ESG into our operations, we build trust and long-term value across our global footprint.
HEALTH SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENT (HSE) GOVERNS EVERYTHING WE DO — AT ALL TIMES

Our Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policy is the foundation of our commitment to sustainability and safety. It defines our core principles and mission, ensuring strict adherence at every operational stage. More than a guideline, it safeguards our employees and stakeholders while driving continuous improvement in our performance.
Our global manufacturing facilities uphold the highest level of quality standards by adhering to the most stringent international standards, including ISO, ASTM, NACE, CSA, and EN.

PERMA-PIPE is a leading global manufacturer of pre-insulated piping, customized piping, pipe coatings, and leak detection systems. We are committed to delivering high-quality products and services that meet the highest industry standards. Through continuous improvement, stringent quality control, and a customer-focused approach, we ensure reliable solutions that exceed expectation and support long-term success.

We understand that each project is unique and requires a customized approach. We take pride in our ability to adapt our quality initiatives to meet the most stringent standards for testing, inspection, and documentation.
